_meta_itemized.notes: A TYPED 2026 filing on the county's own form, and the only one in this chunk whose section-total boxes the filer actually completed - which is what lets both sides gate internally as well as against the cover. NOT ACTUALLY REDACTED ON THE SCHEDULE PAGES despite the '_Redacted.pdf' filename the county publishes it under: neither p2 nor p3 carries any black-marker block, and the contributor's ADDRESS cell prints 'Peoa UT 84061' - city, state and zip with NO street line, i.e. what the filer chose to write. donor_city='Peoa' and donor_state='UT' are therefore read directly from the page and are honest values, not inferred from the zip; the zip itself is not stored. Contrast the Olson 2026 filing (27205) in the same cycle, where the address block IS blacked out by the county. THE EXPENSE PAYEE IS THE CANDIDATE HERSELF: the 'PERSON OR ORGANIZATION' cell reads 'Cindy Keyes', not the county clerk, against the purpose 'Candidate Filing Fee' - a filer convention (she recorded reimbursing herself, or simply named herself as the person who paid), kept verbatim and not normalised to 'Summit County Clerk'. Both pages fill the form's 'Full Name of Candidate:' box with 'Cindy M Keyes'. No specimen rows survive; every other ruled line on both schedules is genuinely blank. The cover carries the same 843.42 in the current-report AND cumulative columns with '$ -' for the last report, so this is the cycle's first filing and no period-vs-cumulative question arises.
